hypothesis: Applying a standard HS300 200-trading-day trend gate only to new entries should reduce exposure to adverse broad-market regimes and improve R253's recent-year and cost-stress behavior without changing the quality ranking or forcing existing positions out before their fixed holding/stop rules.
selection_basis: R253 passed both IC segments and most relative/full-sample gates but failed the recent-12-month, 4x/5x cost and concentration gates. R255 keeps R253 unchanged and tests one standard market-state entry gate. Feasibility shows 100% date coverage from 2023-05-04 with 486 gate-on and 351 gate-off trading days over the full sample; discovery has 114 on/292 off, validation 372 on/59 off, and the recent year 196 on/56 off. No strategy or conditional returns were read before preregistration. Evidence: r255_data_feasibility.json.

factor.formula: hs300_above_ma200 = 1 if 000300.SH close_t > mean(close_{t-199}...close_t), else 0; null until 200 closes exist
factor.interpretation: 1 permits new entries; 0 blocks new entries but does not force existing positions to exit.
factor.pit_rule: Uses only close and the 200-trading-day moving average observable at date t. Order execution remains T+1 open; no future index value is used.
factor.missing_data_rule: Null before the first complete 200-close window. No forward fill across missing index dates beyond an exact date join; a missing gate date blocks new entries fail-closed.
factor.scope: date-constant market-state factor broadcast to every stock row for panel compatibility

strategies.gate_rule: Both strategies require hs300_above_ma200 == 1 for new entries and share the same nonfinancial universe and R253 factor-availability filter. Existing positions are not force-sold by the gate and remain subject to the 20-day holding period and -20% stop.
strategies.weight_rationale: R253's scoring weights are unchanged. The gate is not scored and receives no weight.
strategies.matched_requirements: Both strategies use the same gate, universe, three-component availability filter, 30-name score limit, top 10 equal-weight positions, 20-day holding period, -20% stop loss, T+1 open execution and cost model.

execution.cost_stress: 4x and 5x scale all four cost components proportionally

segments.stitching: compound two independently run segment curves; skip the first return of each later segment

factor_ic.method: R253 quality factor month-end rank IC versus T+1 open to T+21 open return, restricted to gate-on month-end dates within historical non-financial HS300 members

gates.D1: gate date coverage is >= 0.99 in full, discovery, validation and recent-12-month samples
gates.D2: full sample has at least 30 gate-on and 30 gate-off dates; discovery and validation each also have at least 30 gate-on and 30 gate-off dates
gates.D3: 200-trading-day close-only rule and T+1 entry timing audit pass
gates.D4: gate is date-constant for every stock row, complete from 2023-05-04, and has no future-index leakage
gates.I1: gate-on discovery mean R253 rank IC >= 0.02 with at least 6 month-end observations
gates.I2: gate-on validation mean R253 rank IC >= 0.01 with at least 12 month-end observations and the same positive sign
gates.G2: discovery candidate MDD is no worse than control MDD by more than 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample candidate return > 0 and >= control return
gates.G5: full-sample candidate MDD <= 40% in absolute value and no worse than control by more than 5pp
gates.G6: rolling 1-year positive rate >= 60% and no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G7: recent 12-month candidate return > 0 and MDD no worse than control by more than 5pp
gates.G8: full-sample candidate return at 4x cost is positive
gates.G9: full-sample candidate return at 5x cost is positive
gates.C1: at least 30 distinct symbols are traded across the full sample
gates.C2: the largest symbol's share of net P&L is <= 25%
gates.C3: the top three symbols' share of net P&L is <= 55%
gates.C4: the top five symbols' share of net P&L is <= 75%
gates.C5: at least 8 distinct symbols have positive P&L in the validation segment
gates.C6: the largest industry's share of gross profit is <= 45%
gates.C7: the largest single-symbol loss is <= 20% of gross profit in absolute value

decision_rule: All D, I, G and C gates must pass. Any failure means the gated strategy is not accepted and cannot be rescued by changing the moving-average window, gate direction, quality weights, holding period, stop loss, universe, costs or gates after seeing results.
known_limitations: The gate affects new entries only and cannot prevent losses on positions already open.
The 200-day trend rule is a fixed prior, not an optimized parameter, and may whipsaw near the moving average.
The gate is date-constant and has no cross-sectional alpha interpretation.
Conditional discovery IC has only about seven month-end observations under this gate.
The underlying R253 quality factor still carries financial-snapshot, industry-snapshot and concentration risks.
This is another attempt in the same broad quality family, so multiple-comparison risk remains.
Passing these gates would justify further paper-trading validation, not production deployment.
